function: Learned joint STAR-IRS coefficient configuration with task offloading, CPU frequency, quantization bit-width and UAV velocity, minimizing energy plus latency in a UAV-based vehicle-road system (p. 7).
system: Energy-splitting STAR-IRS with discrete phase shifts, F elements, between a UAV-mounted server and J vehicles; UAV antennas and carrier frequency not stated; 180 kHz bandwidth (p. 3, 9).
method: Quantized federated reinforcement learning: adaptive-quantization DDPG (energy) and DDQN (latency), actor-critic with 256-128 hidden layers, vehicles train locally and the STAR-IRS aggregates quantized models (p. 6-9).
data_channel: Custom Python simulator: Rayleigh UAV-vehicle links with path-loss exponent 4 and 30 dB channel gain; no standard model, dataset or measurements; 400 training episodes (p. 3, 9).
test_conditions: Same simulated environment for training and testing; sweeps over transmission power, vehicles, STAR-IRS elements, path-loss exponent, with no stated train/test separation (p. 9-10).
baselines: Only quantized variants of the same agents: GQ-DDPG, Fix (4-bit) and Fix (2-bit) DDPG, GQ-DDQN, Fix (4-bit) and Fix (2-bit) DDQN; no non-learned method (p. 8).
metrics: Energy efficiency, latency, carbon emission, quantization error, accuracy and reward convergence (p. 9-10).
complexity: Time per training iteration: actor O(Lμ nμ²), critic O(LQ nQ²), gradient quantization O(N); space for replay buffer and model; no runtime or FLOPs (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 3: "UAV-vehicle links follow Rayleigh fading" with a path-loss exponent (Table II, p. 9), a custom model. Missing: any 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 9: "Fig. 3(b) illustrates EE trends as the count of vehicles rises." Sweeps over vehicles, STAR-IRS elements, power and path-loss exponent are reported, but the paper never says a policy trained in one setting is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 8: "GQ-DDPG is a reinforcement learning algorithm combining gradient quantization with DDPG"; all six baselines are fixed or gradient quantized variants of the proposed AQ-DDPG and AQ-DDQN. Missing: any non-learned method (random or fixed STAR-IRS, optimization) and any earlier published learned method.
q4_support: p. 11: "The time complexity per training iteration is summarized as follows." It lists actor O(Lμ nμ²), critic O(LQ nQ²), gradient quantization O(N) and a space complexity, in the Complexity Analysis section.
q5_support: p. 9: "Using Python 3.9.13 and TensorFlow 2.14, the simulations are conducted" on a custom simulator. Missing: any code or data link or DOI, and any public or measured channel dataset.
notes: Included as area 3: the agent sets the STAR-IRS coefficient matrix jointly with offloading, CPU frequency, quantization and UAV velocity (action space, p. 7), so above_phy does not apply. Aggregation is digital (the STAR-IRS aggregates quantized models, Algorithm 1, p. 6), so not area 7. A UAV hosts the server but the paper has no NTN framing and no learned power or beam control, so not area 6; reviewer may confirm. q3 is 0 because no non-learned baseline is compared and the learned baselines are variants of the proposed agents.
